As a Van Driver & Logistics Operator, you are the link between our workshop and our customers. You will be responsible for carrying out daily logistics operations across Brussels and throughout Belgium, ensuring that every customer receives a scooter that meets our quality standards.

You will be one of the faces of MUTE on the road and will play a key role in delivering an exceptional customer experience.

Your Responsibilities

Deliveries & Collections

• Deliver electric scooters to customers.
• Collect scooters requiring maintenance or repairs.
• Carry out vehicle swaps when needed.
• Load and unload scooters safely and efficiently.
Logistics Operations

• Optimize routes to maximize operational efficiency.
• Keep the company van clean, organized and in good condition.
• Report any damage or operational issues concerning transported vehicles.
Customer Service

• Represent MUTE professionally during every customer interaction.
• Introduce customers to the basic operation of their scooter upon delivery.
• Answer basic customer questions.
• Ensure every delivery reflects the high service standards of MUTE.
Operational Support

When deliveries are completed, you will support the workshop and logistics team by:

• Moving scooters within the warehouse.
• Preparing vehicles for delivery.
• Cleaning and inspecting scooters.
• Charging and handling batteries safely.
• Assisting the operations team based on daily priorities. 
We are looking for someone who is reliable, proactive and enjoys working independently.

• Valid Category B driving licence (mandatory).
• Comfortable driving a delivery van in urban environments.
• Reliable, punctual and well organized.
• Careful with equipment and company vehicles.
• Able to work independently while maintaining high quality standards.
• Physically fit, as the role involves loading and unloading electric scooters.
Preferred Qualifications

• Previous experience in logistics, deliveries or transportation.
• Interest in electric vehicles or sustainable mobility.
• Experience in the mobility, automotive or technical sector is a plus.
• Good knowledge of Brussels and surrounding areas.

• Good command of English and French.

• 6-month full-time contract (38 hours per week), with the possibility of a permanent contract (CDI) based on performance and business needs.
• A dynamic and fast-growing company.
• A young, international and supportive team.
• A varied role with a high level of autonomy.
• Competitive salary based on experience, plus additional benefits.

jobs.description:
Are you a driven Sales Manager with a passion for consultative, high-level sales? Do you want to make a real impact by selling top-tier MBA programs to ambitious professionals and executives? Then this opportunity in Brussels is for you.

About the Role
As a Sales Manager – MBA Programs, you will be responsible for attracting and enrolling candidates into prestigious, international MBA and Executive Education programs (including HEC Paris).

This is a true hunter role, where you proactively generate new business through outbound activities such as cold calling, networking, events, and strategic relationship building.

Key Responsibilities
 
• Proactively generate leads and new business for MBA and executive education programs 
• Advise professionals and senior executives on career development through MBA pathways 
• Build and maintain strong relationships with C-level and high-potential candidates 
• Organize and follow up on events, info sessions, and networking opportunities 
• Achieve and exceed commercial targets in Brussels and Flanders 
• Develop strategic partnerships with companies and organizations
Your Profile
 
• Proven experience in B2B sales or consultative selling, ideally involving high-value solutions (€35K+) 
• Strong interest in education, executive learning, or MBA programs 
• A true hunter mindset with a passion for generating new opportunities 
• Experience engaging with senior stakeholders and decision-makers 
• Good understanding of the Belgian market (Brussels & Flanders)
Skills & Competencies
 
• Excellent communication and influencing skills in English (C1+) 
• Dutch and/or French is a strong asset 
• Strong prospecting, networking, and relationship-building skills 
• Commercially driven with strategic thinking abilities 
• Ability to translate career goals into tailored MBA solutions 
• Masters Degree
Personality
 
• Ambitious, energetic, and highly results-driven 
• Resilient and persistent, with strong closing skills 
• Consultative mindset: you guide candidates through a key life decision 
• Self-starter, independent, and entrepreneurial 
• Motivated by impact, ownership, and career growth opportunities

As an Associate Scientist II I'm part of a team of biologists of the Janssen Oncology department. My job consists of supporting the Oncology in vivo group efforts in the characterization and development of small molecules and biologics including those that function as immune modulators for the treatment of cancer. I'm responsible for contributing to the ex vivo and in vivo studies for programs across the different stages of pre-clinical drug discovery.

Other responsibilities include the design and execution of in vivo studies for the validation and characterization of targets or therapeutic agents in the area of oncology and tumor immunology. Specifically, to establish and perform in vivo model development, target inhibition, efficacy, mechanism of action, and pharmacokinetic/pharmacodynamics (PK/PD) biomarker studies, and will evaluate the influence of dose, schedule, and therapeutic combinations in various cancer models.

You are available from the second half of August 2026. You will replace a colleague due to pregnancy until May 2027. 

• Working knowledge of the use of Microsoft suite of software products including Excel and Word 
• Experience and knowledge of Good Clinical Practices and regulatory requirements for the conduct of clinical trials and for the appropriate contributions to regulatory filings
•  Fluent in written and spoken English & Dutch
• Felasa B 
* Assist with design, execution, interpretation and reporting for standard in vivo preclinical cancer models.

* Conduct methods of in vivo experimentation, including tumor implantation, dosing, proper handling of chemotherapeutics, tumor measurement, health monitoring, and data collection and analyses.

* Establish and perform in vivo model development.

* May perform bioluminescent imaging studies using molecular reporters or disseminated/ metastatic disease models.

* May assist to analyze data using appropriate statistical methods and preparing data for presentation-ready format.

* Some weekend, evening, and holiday dosing/ animal monitoring required.

ICTS is the trusted partner for trailer rental, fleet maintenance and repairs, field services, and 24/7 roadside assistance. The company provides customers with a complete, worry-free solution for maintenance, servicing, breakdown support, and other on-road services. To strengthen its team, ICTS is looking for an Operations Manager.
 

Ready to take on responsibility within a growing international company? Then you might be the one that we are looking for!
 

JOB DESCRIPTION
 
 

• Leading, coaching and supporting the operational teams in Belgium, the Netherlands and Poland. 

• Organising and overseeing daily operations and rental planning in close cooperation with the workshops. 

• Monitoring the availability and quality of the trailer fleet, including correct inspections at handover and return. 

• Ensuring professional customer service, accurate administration and the proper follow-up of damage cases. 

• Monitoring operational KPI’s, resolving bottlenecks and implementing improvements where needed. 

• Promoting effective cooperation between operations, workshops and administration. 

PROFILE
 
 

• Proven experience in a supervisory or management role within an operational environment, preferably in transport, logistics or a technical sector. 

• A higher education qualification or an equivalent level gained through experience, combined with strong planning and organisational skills. 

• Clear communication, a coaching approach and the confidence to make decisions. 

• A customer-focused, proactive and solution-oriented mindset, even under pressure. 

• Good knowledge of MS Office and the ability to learn new software quickly. 

• Excellent command of Dutch and English, both written and spoken.

Looking for a permanent job on the fixed night shift within an international logistics environment? Then this job might be just the thing for you.

You are fluent in Dutch or English (both spoken and written).

You are a great team player.

Ready to take charge of your own CNC machine and produce high-quality parts?

• Move large workpieces using an overhead crane (certification is a plus, training can be provided internally)
• Work on a fixed machine and fully utilize your expertise
• Program directly at the machine
• Independently produce hydraulic components on CNC machines
• Read technical drawings and determine the optimal workflow

Your Profile:

• Read technical drawings and plan the machining sequence
• Experience with overhead cranes or willingness to learn
• Strict adherence to safety regulations
• Precise and skilled with measuring tools
• Able to program and set up machines independently
• Good knowledge of Dutch, French, or English
• Experience as a CNC milling operator or machinist

Job description 

Depending on your location, you will start your journey from Genk, Antwerp, or Zeebrugge. You are free to choose your own departure time, provided that you leave before 5:00 a.m. Please note that you must inspect the vehicles for any damage before departure. Ensuring the load is properly secured is a key responsibility!

If you prefer to stay overnight during your routes, this can certainly be discussed.

With the loading list assigned to you, you will have a clear overview of your route and know exactly where to go.

Are you able to provide a highly secure parking location for the truck at your home? Great! If not, you will use your own vehicle to travel to the departure location each time and return the truck in excellent condition after completing your route.

You are able to communicate effectively in Dutch, French, and/or English.

 Requirements 

National routes, with occasional trips across the border to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, or France.

No experience is required; we are looking for passion and motivation for vehicle transport.

A CE driving licence, Code 95 qualification, and a valid medical fitness certificate are required.

• Coordinate and oversee all aspects of maritime transportation operations, including vessel scheduling, cargo handling, and port logistics. 
• Liaise with shipping carriers, freight forwarders, and customs authorities to ensure timely and cost-effective cargo movement. 
• Maintain accurate records of cargo shipments, documentation, and tracking information. 
• Maintain strong relationships with existing clients while proactively identifying and developing new business opportunities. 
• Resolve any shipping-related issues or discrepancies in a timely manner. 
• Accomany the GM on client visits as required by business needs (infrequent)
 
• Bachelor's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or a related field is preferred. 
• Over 3 years proven experience in shipping operations or maritime logistics. 
• Familiarity with international shipping regulations and customs procedures. 
• Strong computer skills, including proficiency in MS Office and shipping software. 
• Excellent communication skills.Fluency in French and English, both written and spoken. Knowledge of other languages is a plus. 
• Detail-oriented with strong problem-solving abilities. 
• Ability to work effectively under pressure . 
• Team player with a proactive and positive attitude.

Job description 

Your job in a nutshell
 In the evening, when others go to sleep, your workday begins. Between 22h and 00h, you depart with a refrigerated truck towards your first delivery.
 You drive throughout Belgium and deliver to various supermarkets. No stressful city driving, but clear routes and a well-organised schedule.

What will you do?
 • You load and unload using an electric or manual pallet jack
 • You deliver fruits and vegetables to supermarkets across Belgium
 • You check deliveries and documents
 • You drive independently and take responsibility for your own route
 • You ensure correct and safe deliveries

What does your day look like?
 • You start at night at the depot, pick up your truck and depart on your route
 • During your shift you typically make 2 to 6 stops per night and complete your deliveries efficiently. Your workday lasts on average 12 to 15 hours, but you work within a clear and structured system without chaos or unnecessary stress
 • After your round, you return to the depot (Geel) and your workday is finished—and the best part? You simply sleep at home in your own bed

What do we expect from you?
 • CE driving licence with certificates (Code 95 – medical fitness certificate)
 • Good knowledge of English is a must, Lithuanian is a plus
 • You are flexible and customer-oriented
 • You live in the Geel region
 • You perform physical work with a smile
 • Willingness to work weekends (Saturdays and Sundays)

What do you get in return?
 • A very good salary in relation to your effort and hours
 • Many working hours, no hotel nights—always sleeping at home
 • Working with clear structure and fixed routes
 • Permanent contract after a successful temporary employment period

Interested? Apply today and jump on board!

 Requirements 

• CE driving licence with certificates
 • Flexible mindset
 • Good knowledge of English, Russian or Lithuanian
 • Living in the Geel region

Position overview:
 

 
 

You manage the plant’s environmental, health and safety (EHS), fire safety and property protection (FSPP) sustainability programmes to ensure the safety and well-being of all workers and protection of the environment. You also provide advice and guidance to plant management on EHS, FSPP, sustainability issues, and proactively management of EHS and FSPP risks to ensure the plant meets it compliance obligations and Ball requirements and implements best practice. Coordinate EHS activity, including EHS management systems (ISO and ASI) (certified where applicable). Accountable for rolling out Ball EHS BOE (Ball Operational Excellence) and sustainability initiatives.
 

 
 

Key responsibilities include:
 

 
 
 

• Develop and implement BBS and proactive reporting and engagement initiatives such as near miss, hazard and/or good catch to promote safe behaviours and develop a positive safety culture. 

• Identify and ensure compliance with EHS compliance obligations (e.g. laws, regulations, permits, licences etc) and other stakeholder requirements (e.g. FSPP insurance). 

• Ensure plant management and workers are aware of, take ownership and deliver on their respective EHS accountabilities and responsibilities, including deputies to cover absences. Escalate issues promptly to the plant manager and Regional EHS. 

• Implement and maintain hazard identification and risk assessment programme that reflects hazards during normal, abnormal and emergency conditions and apply the hierarchy of control. Incorporates the Ball BOE, LiFE and hazard mapping into risk management programmes. 

• Identify and assess environment aspects and manage significant impacts under normal, abnormal and emergency conditions including emissions to air, waste, water, wastewater, energy and VOCs. Implement programs to manage significant impacts such as waste minimisation management strategy, pollution prevention, ecological issues. Manage environmental protection infrastructure. 

• Manage the timely reporting, recording, investigation and identification of root causes of EHS incidents and complaints along with oversight of corrective actions including Global reporting via Enablon and Alerts. 

• Work with functional department leaders to develop and implement EHS programmes, requirements, rules, procedures, systems to manage EHS risk and meet all EHS requirements and drive continuous improvement. 

• Establish and implement robust communication and consultation channels to raise awareness, drive engagement, provide information on EHS issues including oversight of the EHS committee and liaison with Safety Representatives. 

• Implement and maintain integrated EHS management systems (and where applicable maintain certification to ISO 14001, ISO 45001, BRC, food safety standards and integrated with ISO 9001) including oversight of external and internal audits, FSPP surveys and management reviews. Follows up on corrective actions. 

• Implement occupational / industrial hygiene, occupational health and well-being programmes in accordance with identified risks and legal requirements in consultation with HR and external providers. 

• Act as primary liaison with regulatory authorities and other external stakeholders (for example insurers, auditors) and internal stakeholders (Regional and Global EHS, Group Insurance, Group Security) and ensure their requirements and reporting are dealt with efficiently. 

What are we looking for?
 

 
 
 

• Min. 5 years of EHS experience, with 3 years management in a similar industry, with proactive shopfloor engagement and comprehensive knowledge of EHS risks and issues. 

• Relevant EHS qualification to a high level (minimum diploma or local equivalent); alternatively engineering qualification with relevant experience of at least 3 years in an EHS managerial role in manufacturing, heavy engineering or construction. 

• Comprehensive knowledge of EHS legislative requirements. 

• Working knowledge of implementing behaviour-based safety programmes. 

• Managing fire safety and property protection insurance risks. 

• Excellent computer skills (Proficient in MS Office Suite). 

• Fluent in written and spoken English and Dutch.

jobs.occupation: Bike mechanic | experienced | day hours no weekend
jobs.description:
For a new company specializing in second-hand e-bikes located in Mechelen, we are seeking skilled bicycle technicians. 

As a Ebike technician, you will work full-time in Mechelen, with working hours from 8 AM to 5 PM. 

Proficiency in Dutch, French, or English is required. 

If you are passionate about refurbishing used e-bikes and transforming them into high-quality bicycles ready for a second life, you might be the candidate we are looking for. 

You will be part of a team dedicated to refurbishing e-bikes from over 200 different brands, ensuring customers have access to a wide selection of high-quality two-wheelers

What you will Do? 

 
• Inspect e-bikes independently, diagnose issues, select parts, repair, and conduct quality checks 
 
• Prepare e-bikes for delivery and maintain the existing fleet in top condition with your team 
 
• Actively contribute to optimizing work processes and the warehouse 
 
• Participate in a project that gives tens of thousands of bicycles a second life annually 
 
• Work in a quiet workshop environment surrounded by high-quality e-bikes 

 
• Comprehensive knowledge of electric bicycles as of 2 years of experience! 
 
• Attention to detail and a passion for perfection 
 
• Willingness to learn continuously and embrace variety 
 
• Interest in testing and improving new repair processes 
 
• Good knowledge of English, French or Dutch

Interested?
If you are the bicycle technician we are searching for, please respond promptly using the application button. 

The initial selection will be based on your resume. We look forward to learning more about your skills and experience. 
Your application is the first step in joining a team that values expertise and dedication in the field of bicycle refurbishment.
